purpose: Track current and proposed semantic-shadow data sources so source-heavy veto experimentation stays explicit, comparable, and approval-aware.

sources.label: Reviewed benchmark trigger families
sources.expected_value: High-precision control lane for overlap and veto lower-bound measurement.
sources.main_risk: Not production-eligible; can hide automatic seed weakness if treated as more than a control.

sources.label: Rulegen top-N English source phrases
sources.expected_value: Production-shaped trigger seeding from the same LP admission/rulegen surface.
sources.main_risk: Coverage is still weak without supplementary source data.

sources.label: Forward glossary fragment seeding
sources.expected_value: Source-only coverage boost for missing English triggers and sibling discovery.
sources.main_risk: Quickly introduces noise if phrase length or thresholding is too loose.

sources.label: Current lexical inventory lanes
sources.expected_value: Current baseline from reverse lookup, forward index, lexical bridge, neighbor borrow, and support scoring.
sources.main_risk: Still leaves both empty-pool misses and near-neighbor overblocking unresolved.

sources.label: Target-card embedding bridge
sources.expected_value: Recall probe for lexical misses like harder semantic bridges.
sources.main_risk: Current best rows show strong overblocking pressure.

sources.label: Target frequency metadata
sources.expected_value: Optional weak prior for condensation and feature analysis.
sources.main_risk: Current sweeps do not support making it a default blocker-selection signal.

sources.label: Wiktionary sense and translation inventory
sources.expected_value: Likely strongest next structured coverage source for missing sibling senses and trigger links.

sources.label: Open Multilingual WordNet style graph
sources.expected_value: Coarse sense-graph coverage and semantic-neighborhood constraints for broad ambiguity families.
sources.main_risk: Learner-facing sense mapping may be too coarse or too mismatched.

sources.label: Aligned phrase or translation table
sources.expected_value: Coverage for phrase-sensitive blockers and MWE leakage families.
sources.main_risk: High noise floor unless combined with strong downstream gating.

sources.label: Example sentence bank
sources.expected_value: Better near-neighbor discrimination and stronger future runtime evidence text.

sources.label: LLM-generated shadow proposals
sources.expected_value: Cheap recall expansion for hard lexical misses after strict downstream filtering.

sources.label: LLM-generated anchors or cues
sources.expected_value: Richer runtime-facing evidence once blocker identities are already known.
sources.main_risk: Natural-sounding but semantically weak cue text.
